description: The odds board: every game of a league with its game lines (moneyline, spread, total) in one call, grouped by game. Use it instead of reading games one at a time: "what are tonight's NBA lines?", "show me every NFL spread this week". Pass date (US Eastern YYYY-MM-DD) for one day, market_type for other families (comma list, or all), and changed_since (an ISO time such as the last call's meta.as_of) to get only markets that moved. With no sport or league it reads the league with the most open game lines. A default call costs 4 credits (table: https://fanduelapi.com/credits).

changed_since.description: ISO time: only markets that moved after it.

date.description: One US Eastern calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

league.description: League code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, NCAAB, NCAAF, or a soccer league such as EPL, LALIGA, UCL, MLS.

market_type.description: Comma list of market families (moneyline, spread, total, team_total, alt_spread, alt_total, ...) or all. Default moneyline,spread,total.

period.description: game (default), a period such as h1 or q1, or any.

sport.description: Sport, lower case, for example basketball, football, hockey, baseball.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: odds_board
